Design principles.source-defined: Values and seven principles are read from the design philosophy.

Application across the product.not-assessed: The viewer links principles to relevant topics; product-wide adherence has not been assessed.

UI role scale.source-defined: Complete current heading, body, label and weight registrations.

Font families.implementation-only: Native interface/monospace stacks and the workbench baseline come from product CSS, not family tokens.

Role-specific line height and tracking.source-defined: Metric registrations are present; review their role coverage.
Role-specific line height and tracking.not-defined-in-covered-sources: A role-specific line-height/tracking scale is not registered here; the workbench baseline is an implementation value.

Spacing scale.source-defined: Every registered spacing step is shown, including zero.

Product spacing patterns.implementation-only: Curated CSS examples illustrate associations, fields, sibling controls, insets, section breaks, and narrow layouts; they are not universal semantic aliases.

Named semantic spacing roles.source-defined: Named spacing aliases are present; their usage should be reviewed.
Named semantic spacing roles.not-defined-in-covered-sources: The numeric ramp is defined, but named spacing roles such as within-group/between-group are not registered in the covered size source.

Radius scale.source-defined: Every registered radius is shown; the fully rounded value is distinct from a larger corner.

Surface-role guidance.source-defined: Control, inner and outer tiers are documented, along with fully rounded pills.

Icon dimensions.source-defined: Base and compact glyph sizes are defined; stroke is a separate topic.

Control height, density and hit-area sca.source-defined: Sizing registrations are present; their usage coverage has not been assessed.
Control height, density and hit-area sca.not-defined-in-covered-sources: Named control-height, density and hit-area scales are not defined in this size registry. These glyph/stroke examples are not a complete component sizing system.

Product control geometry.implementation-only: Button, Switch, and SelectBox geometry is read from the owning styles, preserving density and platform differences.
Product control geometry.not-assessed: The covered sources do not include component geometry. Icon registrations do not establish control dimensions or hit targets.

Registered stroke.source-defined: The base registry defines a single stroke thickness.

Boundary and scrollbar recipes.implementation-only: Control borders, keyboard-focus offsets, contrast borders, scrollbar states, track defaults, and the thumb minimum come from owning sources.
Boundary and scrollbar recipes.not-assessed: The covered stroke registry does not include component boundaries, scrollbar geometry, or their interaction states.

Semantic color roles.source-defined: Theming guidance groups surface, text, input, list and widget colors; examples use actual theme values.

Runtime color-default coverage.present: The registry inventory resolves supported definitions and defaults, but computed runtime expressions remain explicit. An unresolved default is not evidence that the product lacks the color.
Runtime color-default coverage.absent: This reader covers explicit theme declarations and ANSI defaults, not every runtime color expression. An unresolved example is not evidence that the design system lacks that color.

Theme mappings.source-defined: Contributed themes and a bounded set of source-registered defaults supply the comparisons.

High-contrast guidance.source-defined: Use solid backgrounds, explicit contrast borders and focus indicators; do not rely on shadows.

Glyph catalog.source-defined: The full catalog comes from Codicon registrations.

Glyph sizing and naming guidance.source-defined: Base/compact glyphs, accessible names and text labels are documented.

Motion intent.source-defined: Motion should guide, confirm or orient, remain interruptible, and preserve meaning with reduced motion.

Named timing and easing system.source-defined: Patterns, timing, curves and reduced-motion behavior are projected from the selected checkout’s motion definitions.
Named timing and easing system.not-defined-in-covered-sources: No complete motion token and recipe catalog is defined in the covered source paths. Existing CSS observations are not a published motion system.

Current implementation examples.implementation-only: Representative CSS declarations are observations, not the canonical motion system.

Constraint-based layout guidance.source-defined: SplitView/Grid, minimum sizes, priorities and responsive constraints are documented.

Named composition recipes.not-defined-in-covered-sources: The covered layout guidance describes constraints and reusable containers. It does not define a named composition-recipe catalog.

Shadow definitions.source-defined: Named elevation shadow CSS variables are defined in workbench CSS; they are not registered size tokens.

Shadow-tier usage guidance.not-defined-in-covered-sources: The covered theming guidance does not define a universal shadow-to-surface mapping. Preserve consumer-specific settings and high-contrast behavior.

Product usage.present: The notification example is one observed consumer, not a universal mapping.
Product usage.absent: The covered consumer has no selected shadow declaration; broader usage is not assessed.
